summary.headline: Lord of the Year by Place
summary.text: Astrological instructions for judging the lord of the year: its house identifies matters such as death, travel, kingship, friends, or enemies, while its sign, term, exaltation, triplicity, climate, and city indicate stronger or weaker outcomes for kings and peoples. Chapter XVI begins by directing the astrologer to assign planets to climates and assess those born under the relevant signs.
